title: High Bandwidth Memory 4 (HBM4) Package Development Challenges
venue: 2026 IEEE/JSAP Symposium on VLSI Technology and Circuits
orgs: SK hynix America Inc.; SK hynix Inc.
notes: 12-layer HBM4 MTV4 by MR-MUF: void-free C-SAM, daisy chain stable after precon/uHAST/TC (no axis values). Simulation: Si interposer vs Si bridge vs advanced substrate, relative stress only.

title: Demonstration and Challenges of Through Si Interposer (TSI) with 5-layer Frontside Cu Metal and 2-layer Backside Cu RDL
orgs: Institute of Microelectronics, Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)
notes: 300 mm via-first TSI: 10x100 um Cu TSV, 5 FS 1 um Cu BEOL, 2 BS 3 um Cu RDL, Cu/Ni/Au UBM; warpage per step (AU); 100-TSV chain 28-31 ohm.

title: Reliability Challenges of High-Density Fan-out Packaging for High-Performance Computing Applications
notes: MediaTek chip-first fan-out module (SoC + 8 I/O dies, 3 RDL) on 74x74 and 91x91 mm substrates; RDL2 trace cracks after multi-reflow fixed by FEA-guided redesign; JEDEC pass.

title: First Demonstration of a 200×200 mm2 Glass Substrate for Large Area Packages
notes: 200x200 mm, 1 mm glass with ABF GL102 2ML SAP; 64-coupon open/short yield and plating maps; simulated UCIe-S x8 10 mm channel; ASTRA-sim system study.

title: Laser micro drilling of around 3 microns into Ajinomoto Build-up Film
orgs: The University of Tokyo; Ajinomoto Fine-Techno Co. Inc.; Spectronix Co.; Mitsubishi Electric Co.
notes: Model substrate: 3 um ABF over 3 um sputtered Cu lines on D 263 glass; 266 nm ps laser drills 3 um vias at 5 um pitch, >10,000 vias/s. No reliability or metallization.
